entities.name: old willow on the far bank (leaning trunk)
entities.what: Old pollarded willow with a thick trunk leaning north-west from the bank top, its knobby head at about (17130, 45-90) sprouting a wide fan of long, thin, bare whips that curve over the far-bank booth and the walled building to the west and run off the silk's top edge. Early spring: no leaves.
entities.vis: part: crown cut by the silk's top edge
entities.note: Trunk from the head (17123-17145, 45-90) down through (17150-17165, 130-170) to its foot at (17172-17195, 214-227); a dark stroke continues from the foot to (17200, 245) toward the water (a root or the bank's edge). The whips reach west to u ~16890 and up past the silk's top edge (v ~10), so top is est. SPECIES: the scan shows long fine whips curving down at their ends (willow); the tile restyle paints a bare forked tree here, moved ~60 px east. Next to S3.tree.willow_far_17205 (second trunk, own foot): the two may be read as one two-stemmed willow; I count two trees because the feet are 35 px apart.

entities.name: second willow on the far bank (upright trunk)
entities.what: Upright pollarded willow just north-east of the leaning one, a straight slender trunk with a knobby head at about (17170-17215, 55-75) and a fan of long bare whips spreading east over the far-bank eating place to about u 17310 and off the silk's top edge.
entities.vis: part: crown cut by the silk's top edge
entities.note: Trunk u 17190-17210, v 55-190, foot (17200-17218, 182-191), about 30 px north of the leaning willow's foot. Both readings: a separate tree (my reading) or a second stem of S3.tree.willow_far_17185. Second pass: two trees, settled as far as the strokes go. This upright trunk (u 17191-17200) ends on open ground at v ~186-190, about 10 px east of S3.tree.willow_far_17185's leaning trunk at the same height (that trunk runs down to (17182-17202, 222-247)); the ground between them is plain, so the two do not fork from one stool (crops c_willowfork.jpg, c_willows17200.jpg).

entities.name: small standing figure under the far willow
entities.what: Small figure in a light robe standing on the far bank between the leaning willow trunk and the booth to the west; too small and faint to read the dress further.
entities.note: Feet u 17127-17136, v 158-165. Painted height about 45 px (street figures 150-160 px: about 0.3). t2 reads the same figure: foot (17130, 163), head (17123, 127).

entities.name: standing figure beside the upright willow
entities.what: Small figure in a light robe standing just west of the upright willow trunk, under the far-bank booth's eave beam.
entities.note: Outline u 17165-17182, v 99-152 with a round head at (17172, 100-107). Both readings: a figure (my reading) or a post with a crossbar at v 91-95 under the eave. Painted height about 53 px.

entities.name: faint figure at the west end of the far-bank table
entities.what: Faint dark upright shape standing at the west end of the far-bank eating table, east of the upright willow trunk.
entities.note: Strokes u 17202-17222, v 102-155, an oval at (17207-17217, 105-115). Both readings: a standing figure (customer or server) or the table's bench seen end-on plus a branch of the willow. The restyle (shifted here) paints small figures around the table.

entities.name: man seated on a bench at the far-bank table
entities.what: Man in a light robe seated on a bench, hunched forward and facing west toward a small table under the far-bank eating place's eave.
entities.note: Seated on S3.prop.far_bank_bench_17278. Body u 17267-17291, v 100-137; feet hidden by the bench (est).

entities.name: small table beside the slatted stand

entities.name: bench under the seated man
entities.what: Low bench on splayed legs on which the hunched man sits, east of the small table.

entities.name: long counter table of the far-bank eating place
entities.what: Long table with a plain board apron across its front, running east-west under the eating place's eave; two men sit behind it facing the river.
entities.note: Top line v 128-132 from u 17300 to 17392; the apron's lower edge at v 160-162; legs at u ~17302, 17343, 17392. Back corners est. SCALE: 90 px long at v 160.

entities.name: empty square table under the far-bank shed (west)
entities.what: Empty square table with stretchers between its legs, standing under the open mat-roofed shed east of the eating place.

entities.name: bench in front of the west shed table
entities.what: Long bench in front of (south of) the empty square table, running east-west.

entities.name: bench end-on east of the west shed table

entities.name: bench in front of the east shed table
entities.what: Long bench in front of (south of) the east square table.

entities.name: the far-bank eating place under the willows
entities.what: An open eating place on the far bank under the two willows: a small table with a man hunched on a bench facing it, and a long counter table with two men seated behind it facing the river; a faint figure stands at the west table.
entities.note: The building over it is structures_w's.

entities.name: 十千脚店 lamp-box sign at the gate
entities.what: Tall box-shaped standing lamp sign with an ornamented crest, at the west side of 十千脚店's gate behind the picket fence. Front (south) face, top to bottom: 腳店 (written 腳, the full form of 脚); east side face, top to bottom: 十千 (十 clear, 千 fairly clear). Together: 十千腳店.
entities.vis: part: foot hidden behind the picket fence
entities.note: Box u 17003-17068, v 1550-1690 (crest v 1550-1578; front face u 17003-17052; side face u 17052-17068). Its bottom meets the fence's top rail at v ~1692, so it either stands on the ground behind the fence (foot est) or sits on the fence. SCALE: box 65 px wide, 140 px tall. Free-standing as painted, so recorded as a tile prop (t2 and the brief: "structures_w's unless it stands on its own"); if structures_w also writes it into the gate's what, keep this entry. The restyle rewrites the characters. Merge: structures_w recorded the same board as S3.prop.shiqian_jiaodian_lampbox_17034 (retired as a duplicate) with the same writing (脚店 large on the front, 十千 small and faint on the right, med) and the board at u 17000-17068, v 1548-1690; it read the foot at the silk's edge (17034, 1792, est), standing at the west part of the gate's bar fence (S3.str.gate_fence_16955). Kept here as the tile prop; it is a member of the tavern group S3.grp.shiqian_jiaodian_16800.

entities.name: saddled horse without rider at the tavern gate
entities.what: Pale horse, saddled and bridled but with no rider, standing at 十千脚店's gate with its head lowered to the ground at the west and its rump toward the viewer: a saddle with a long dark saddle flap on its near side, a crupper with two hanging tassels, the tail tied up in a knot; the inside of its near hind leg is painted dark. One hind hoof is lifted.
entities.vis: part: hooves at the silk's bottom edge
entities.note: Head u 17170-17215, v 1680-1765 (muzzle at (17200, 1760)); near fore hoof (17225, 1770), a far fore leg possibly at (17172, 1770); hind hooves (17295, 1770) planted and (17282, 1755) lifted, another hind leg to (17352, 1770). Rump u 17257-17360, v 1595-1727; saddle and empty seat at about (17260-17320, 1590-1612); saddle flap u 17223-17253, v 1603-1700; tassels at (17273, 1663) and (17280, 1735). The silk's bottom edge is at v ~1774. NO RIDER IS PAINTED: the brief's "rider at the gate (17000-17150)" is this riderless horse. Nobody holds it at the head; the figure at the gate's east post (S3.fig.gate_post_figure_17332) may be its groom (unclear). SCALE: rump to muzzle about 190 px; withers height not readable (back at v ~1600 over hooves at 1770: about 170 px).

entities.name: figure at the gate's east post holding out a small thing
entities.what: Narrow figure in a long robe standing at the east post of the tavern's gate, half hidden behind the gate's lattice panel, his arm held out east with a small object in the hand (a flower, a whip or a small bundle).
entities.vis: part: behind the gate's lattice panel
entities.note: Robe u 17320-17340, v 1452-1610; hand (17348-17358, 1562-1572); feet (17325-17340, 1605-1612). Head not legible behind the panel's top (est). The restyle paints two people here: a man in a grey robe (head ≈ (17315, 1425)) and a figure in a red robe (u 17267-17300, v 1470-1590); the scan shows one narrow figure, with the lattice panel's bars where the red figure would be. Maybe the horse's groom or a tavern servant.

entities.name: big parasol over the stall by the gate
entities.what: Big parasol on a pole, its dark canopy tilted toward the viewer and ribbed from a hub, shading a stall table east of the tavern's gate; a knob at its top.
entities.vis: part: pole hidden by the table
entities.note: Canopy u 17312-17482, v 1178-1315 (rim v 1293-1315); ribs radiate from a hub at (17370, 1213); a dark knob at (17410-17432, 1175-1195) at its top. The pole shows below the rim at u ~17408 (v 1313-1335) and its foot is hidden behind the table (est). SCALE: canopy 170 px across. The restyle ties a rope from the scaffold to its knob; the scan shows only faint lines there. Brief's hint "big parasol by the gate (17330-17500, v 1150-1300)": confirmed.

entities.name: stall table under the parasol
entities.what: Stall table with a dark top under the big parasol, its top seen tilted toward the viewer, splayed legs; dark things are stowed under it. The restyle sets a teapot, cups and buns on it (not legible on the scan).
entities.note: Top: a dark quadrilateral, north edge from (17352, 1335) to its north-east corner (17433, 1337), south corner near (17362, 1392); south-east leg slanting from (17407, 1357) to its foot (17423, 1390); dark masses under it at u 17320-17400, v 1375-1400. Base is the middle of the front legs (south-east leg visible, the rest est). SCALE: top about 100 px east-west.

entities.name: man standing behind the stall table under the parasol
entities.what: Man standing behind (north of) the east end of the stall table; only his legs in light trousers and his feet show below the parasol's canopy, which hides his body and head.
entities.vis: part: body and head hidden by the canopy
entities.note: Legs u 17427-17460, v 1312-1340, a foot pointing east at (17435-17460, 1335-1342). Head est from a 150 px figure. Both readings: a figure (the restyle paints legs and shoes here) or the parasol's pole and a stall frame.

entities.name: faint seated figure at the west end of the stall table
entities.what: Possible stall-keeper seated behind the west end of the stall table under the parasol's west edge.
entities.note: A faint rounded shape (a head?) at (17310-17330, 1302-1320) above the table's west end, among the gate's posts and the scaffold's diagonal. Both readings: a seated stall-keeper (the restyle paints one in white, holding a cup) or the gate's posts and the parasol's rim.

entities.name: the parasol stall by the tavern gate
entities.what: A stall under a big tilted parasol just east of 十千脚店's gate: a table with things stowed under it, a man standing behind its east end and perhaps a seated keeper at its west end.

entities.name: man in knee breeches walking with a dark bundle
entities.what: Man in a short jacket over a wrapped skirt, knee breeches and leg wraps, walking toward the viewer and the west, head turned to the left (west); he carries a dark shaggy bundle (straw or hemp, possibly a hat held by its strings) low in his right hand.
entities.note: Feet (17360-17385, 1545-1555) and (17410-17432, 1545-1557); head (17365-17395, 1392-1420); the bundle u 17400-17432, v 1442-1485 with hanging strands. Painted height about 160 px. The restyle paints him in a blue jacket with a dark cap in his hand.

entities.name: man with a topknot handling the 串车's load
entities.what: Man with a topknot in a light jacket with a dark apron or sash, standing at the west end of the 串车 and looking down; he grips a large dark shaggy bundle (a coil of rope or a straw mat) on the cart's load, his right arm bent toward the west.

entities.note: Head (17485-17515, 1331-1365), face looking down-left; dark sash u 17445-17462, v 1400-1420; bundle u 17470-17545, v 1380-1440. Legs show at u 17445-17468 down to v ~1455 behind the cart's west poles; feet hidden (est). He stands north of the poles' ground tips (v 1529-1554), behind the cart's west end. entities.vis: part: body hidden behind the cart's load
entities.note: Cap top (17530-17557, 1314-1325), face (17530-17545, 1328-1352), hand (17522-17545, 1365-1372). Foot est straight below the head, behind the load: within about 15 px of t4's boundary (17550), t4 did not record him (it names him as t3's). entities.note: Child u 17503-17537, v 1671-1773; its hand on the man's robe at (17533, 1691). Painted height 100 px, about 0.56 of the man beside it (180 px).
